result:
`bun run typecheck` passes and `bun test` is 8/8 green (`bunx guren check` reports 0 failures too).

The bug was the route pattern `/posts/archive/:date*` in `routes/web.ts:35`. A path param never spans a `/`, and Hono reads that whole label as a param *named* `date*` — so `/posts/archive/2026` matched but exposed no `date` param (hence the 422 "required value missing"), and `/posts/archive/2026/08`, being two segments, matched nothing at all (404). I replaced it with one route per URL shape — `/posts/archive/:year/:month` named `posts.archive.month`, registered before `/posts/archive/:year` named `posts.archive`, both still ahead of `/posts/:id` — and swapped `ArchiveParamSchema` in `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts` for `ArchiveParamsSchema`, which validates a four-digit `year` plus an optional `month` matching `0?[1-9]|1[0-2]` (so `08` and `8` both pass and `13`/`00` get a 422). `PostController.archive` now reads `{ year, month }`, builds the same `YYYY-MM-` / `YYYY-` prefix LIKE filter against the stored UTC `createdAt` string, and orders by `createdAt` desc with `id` desc as tiebreaker so results are genuinely newest-first. I regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` and added `tests/PostArchive.test.ts`, which seeds posts with explicit `createdAt` values and covers the month, no-leading-zero, year, empty-period, out-of-range-month, and malformed-year cases; nothing outside the archive changed.
